mapper.select: select knowledge_id, source_type, source_id, problem, solution, status, create_time, update_time from ai_knowledge
select * from ai_chat_session where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc
select * from ai_chat_message where conversation_id = #{conversationId} order by message_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into ai_chat_message(conversation_id, role, content) values(#{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content})
insert into ai_question_log(user_id, question, matched_knowledge_id, similarity) values(#{userId}, #{question}, #{matchedKnowledgeId}, #{similarity})
